# Run receiver-sensitive comptime methods natively and with upstream Go.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_method_nested_review328.lgo comptime_method_nested_review328/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_method_nested_review328.out comptime_method_nested_review328/expected.txt
cd comptime_method_nested_review328
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_method_receiver_review328.lgo comptime_method_receiver_review328/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_method_receiver_review328.out comptime_method_receiver_review328/expected.txt
cd comptime_method_receiver_review328
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_method_renamed_review328.lgo comptime_method_renamed_review328/main.lgo

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_method_promoted_review328.lgo comptime_method_promoted_review328/main.lgo
